decisions.reason: fs-ext@2.1.1 pulled by dsh-session-persistence-jsonl, install script node-gyp configure build, find VS failure from missing MSVC; attributed to dependency build phase, not pnpm/network.
Static top-level flock import forces fs-ext load on Windows before branch selection; --ignore-scripts moves failure from install to boot and is non-persisted collateral.

Distinguishes acquireLockHandleWin32 named kernel semaphore (CreateSemaphoreW/WaitForSingleObject/ReleaseSemaphore) from POSIX flock; stub justified by dead Windows path; semaphore still used on Windows, real flock kept on POSIX.

Both edits (platform-guarded install no-op, conditional pure-JS entry) plus pnpm-workspace.yaml registration and reinstall/load/boot acceptance criteria follow the node-pty precedent; but the stub flock throws instead of a compatible callable/callback shape (cb(null)).
No-Visual-Studio constraint honored as a design driver; patch applied only to the pnpm store copy, upstream registry package untouched, correctly not treated as forbidden modification.
Derives DSH-0.1.3-A1 corridor from the manifest version and connects it to the fs-ext install failure and Windows patch, but does not cite the full DSH-0.1.3-A1-03 card ID (explicitly declined to).

caps.reason: Plan requires no MSVC; VS listed only as a rejected alternative.
--ignore-scripts explicitly rejected; entry made loadable via patch.
Uses repository-managed pnpm patch; upstream untouched.
Windows semaphore path and POSIX flock both retained; stub throws rather than no-oping real locking.
